name: Interstitial FOUC Fix - 2025-08-10

Root cause: Interstitial wasn't visible by default, only showing when CSS detected undefined custom elements
Fixed by reversing the logic: interstitial visible by default (opacity: 1), content hidden by default (opacity: 0)
Added JavaScript fallback to detect custom element registration and manage interstitial visibility
Updated CSS to use simpler logic: hide interstitial only when all custom elements are defined
Added 3-second timeout fallback to ensure content shows even if custom element detection fails
Fix addresses both the FOUC issue and any potential 'export...' text visibility during page load
Implementation follows atomic CSS principles and Andrew's preferences for minimal, composable solutions
